Job-level env could not reference job.services; the consuming step env was accepted
Original Gitless job image entered checkout REST fallback and job containers timed out; host HTTP consumers passed
All job-container checkouts passed; locked Node26.12.0 then failed to load libatomic.so.1

archives.format: gzip JSON containing each original ZIP as base64 with independent byte count and SHA256

boundaries: Functional controls, not provider timing benchmarks or an application-wide CI acceptance.
The service runs Node24; the separate consumer executes and hashes locked Node26 and verifies a loaded libatomic mapping.
Native ZIPs have API size plus local hash and CRC checks; GitHub ZIP hashes also match server-reported API digests.
Secret absence is verified for only the exact owned variants; this is not a claim that the opaque pull token was revoked.
The original Gitless REST fallback timeout and missing library are separate fixture incidents.
Registry write-denial and OCI graph/source proofs are retained by the separate BuildKit campaign.
